name: General Investment License (ZIDA)

requirements.blocker_text: The Zimbabwe Investment and Development Agency (ZIDA) issues a General Investment License to registered companies (application fee USD 577.50, license fee USD 4,620 upon approval), which then assists the investor in securing post-investment permits and approvals -- including residence and work permits -- issued through other agencies and ministries. No minimum capital threshold was confirmed in the source reviewed, and the license itself is distinct from, and a precondition for, the residence/work permits it helps secure.
requirements.fix_path: Register a company, obtain ZIDA's General Investment License, then apply separately for the resulting residence/work permits.

evidence_required.document: Company registration documents (Memorandum and Articles of Association)

sources.title: Zimbabwe Investment and Development Agency (ZIDA) -- official General Investment License process, fees, and its role in securing subsequent residence/work permits

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Zimbabwe). STATUS: DRAFT despite tier-1 sourcing (ZIDA is Zimbabwe's statutory investment promotion authority, treated as a government source consistent with this dataset's embassy/agency convention) -- the page details the LICENSE fully but does not specify a minimum capital threshold or the resulting residence permit's exact duration/terms, so this route is modeled thinly on the outcome side despite solid sourcing on the process side. This mirrors DR Congo's ANAPI-based investor route built earlier in this dataset -- a real, government-documented APPROVAL process paired with an under-documented RESIDENCE outcome. family_can_join set false (not asserted true without a source); family_can_work and duration left null/unspecified for the same reason.
